what_happened.line: The Select Board deferred its recommendation on the TC Passios renovation article to town meeting, noting a renovation would require a debt exclusion.
The board amended the Article 9 design funding article, deleting the phrase on bid preparation for construction and raising the amount, then deferred it to town meeting.
The board voted to recommend approval of most other special town meeting articles, including the sewer enterprise budget amendment; Article 6 was pulled by the assessors for more work.
The board interviewed three landscape architect firms for 30 School Street; scores go to the town manager and a firm is to be chosen at a later meeting.
The board accepted the 2020 re-precincting plan and chose hazardous materials abatement at the old primary school for its state supplemental budget earmark request.

why_it_matters: Passios renovation would need a debt exclusion, so residents at town meeting will be asked to vote on a question that could add to property tax bills beyond the usual levy limit.
The design funding amount was raised by amendment, so the figure on the town meeting warrant differs from the one first drafted.
watch_next: November 2nd: the board is expected to open price proposals and choose a landscape architect firm for 30 School Street.
The special town meeting votes on Articles 8, 9 and 15, which the board deferred without a recommendation.
